scripts.initialize:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m venv .venv
npm install --prefix .venv/toolchain --no-save --no-package-lock node@22
export PATH="$PWD/.venv/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin:$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"
npm ci
python -m pip install -r requirements-test.txt
python -m playwright install chromium
git ls-tree -r HEAD -- package.json package-lock.json .npmrc vendor requirements-test.txt | git hash-object --stdin > .venv/setup-inputs
scripts.refresh:
set -euo pipefail
inputs=$(git ls-tree -r HEAD -- package.json package-lock.json .npmrc vendor requirements-test.txt | git hash-object --stdin)
if [[ -d node_modules && -x .venv/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin/node && -x .venv/bin/python && -f .venv/setup-inputs && $(cat .venv/setup-inputs) == "$inputs" ]]; then exit 0; fi
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m venv .venv
npm install --prefix .venv/toolchain --no-save --no-package-lock node@22
export PATH="$PWD/.venv/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin:$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"
npm ci
python -m pip install -r requirements-test.txt
python -m playwright install chromium
git ls-tree -r HEAD -- package.json package-lock.json .npmrc vendor requirements-test.txt | git hash-object --stdin > .venv/setup-inputs

startup.name: dev
startup.command:
set -eu
export PATH="$PWD/.venv/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin:$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"
exec npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort
